$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0211-invalid-unknown-substratetype.xml (Rule 10, D-030). NEGATIVE CASE: SubstrateType="Puck" is not a member of SubstrateTypeEnum in any revision. The enumeration has GROWN TWICE - V0125 added TnR, Panel and PCB to the classic Wafer/Frame/Strip/Tray set - so an unknown token is at least as likely to be a newer standard as a typo, and refusing the document would make this engine reject the next revision.
